ownership.quote: Big news: We’re joining Cloudflare. Replicate’s going to carry on as a distinct brand, and all that’ll happen is that it’s going to get way better.

stage.note: Replicate was acquired by / joined Cloudflare (announced 2025-11-17) and continues as a distinct brand; its last independent priced round was a $40M Series B (Dec 2023), so pre-acquisition stage was series-b.

total_funding_usd.basis: Aggregator figure (~$57.8M per AI-summarized Crunchbase-style snippet; growjo.com separately estimates total funding at $58M) matching sum of seed (undisclosed, part of $17.8M pre-Series-A total) + $12.5M Series A (Feb 2023) + $40M Series B (Dec 2023)
total_funding_usd.quote: Replicate, a startup that runs machine learning models in the cloud, today launched out of stealth with $17.8 million in venture capital backing; $12.5 million of the total came from a Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz with participation from Y Combinator, Sequoia and angel investors

last_round.quote: we’ve raised a $40 million Series B led by a16z ... It’s led by a16z, and joined by NVentures (NVIDIA), Heavybit, Sequoia, and Y Combinator.

revenue.basis: GetLatka estimate; growjo.com separately estimates current annual revenue at $6.3M
revenue.quote: Replicate generated an estimated $5.3M in annual revenue in 2024. Source: GetLatka estimate

note: Independent startup (YC W20, founded 2018-2019 by Ben Firshman [ex-Docker] and Andreas Jansson [ex-Spotify]) that raised seed + $12.5M Series A (Feb 2023, a16z-led, $17.8M total at launch) then a $40M Series B (Dec 2023, a16z-led). On 2025-11-17 Replicate announced it is joining Cloudflare (acquisition/acqui-integration); it continues to operate as a distinct brand with an unchanged API and no pricing change observed as of 2026-09-29. Revenue figures are third-party estimates (GetLatka $5.3M for 2024, growjo ~$6.3M current), not company-confirmed.
